test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

All the entries must have been verified by the auditor before submission.

options.text: All the entries are to be verified before submission.
The auditor was verifying all entries before submission.
The auditor must have verified all the entries before submission.
All entries were verified by the auditor.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in the passive voice: "All the entries must have been verified by the auditor before submission."
 
• In the active voice, the subject (the auditor) is the doer of the action.
 
• The active voice structure ensures that the auditor is explicitly performing the action of verifying the entries.
 
• Thus, the correct transformation is: "The auditor must have verified all the entries before submission."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The auditor must have verified all the entries before submission."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "All the entries are to be verified before submission."** – This is in the passive voice, and the modal verb "must" is omitted, changing the meaning.
 
• **Option 2: "The auditor was verifying all entries before submission."** – This is not correct as it uses the past continuous tense, which changes the meaning of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "All entries were verified by the auditor."** – This is in the past simple tense and passive voice, which changes the tense and meaning.
 
• **Option 5:** There is no Option 5 provided in the question.
